obs = observe()
cands = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Select candidate closest to 90 degrees relative to long axis
pen_long_yaw = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]["long_axis_yaw"]
best_cand = min(
    cands,
    key=lambda c: abs(
        abs(c["yaw"] - pen_long_yaw) - math.pi / 2
    ),
)
grasp_res = grasp(best_cand)

if grasp_res["holding_something"]:
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

    # Carry above the pen holder, clear of the rim
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.12)

    # Lower slightly into or directly above the holder opening
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)

go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
